spec.title: Hummingbot Pair Trade (Mobin Gold) v7
spec.description: v7 trimmed: prior-session-close P&L baseline; default session = latest; default time = today 12:02 → now (Asia/Tehran). Weight labels = static IR→Persian map. Gapless 12:00–18:00 Asia/Tehran. Benchmark panels kept (optimize later).

spec.__legacyStringValue: SELECT name AS __text, name AS __value FROM pair_trade.strategy ORDER BY name;

SELECT s.id::text || ' @ ' || to_char(s.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text, s.id AS __value FROM pair_trade.session s JOIN pair_trade.strategy st ON st.id = s.strategy_id WHERE st.name = '$strategy' ORDER BY s.started_at DESC;

spec.title: P&L (%)
spec.description: 100 * (latest_NAV / prior_close_NAV − 1); prior-session last NAV shared baseline.

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
anchor AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.started_at, s.strategy_id
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  WHERE s.id IN ($session)
  ORDER BY s.started_at
  LIMIT 1
),
prev_session AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  JOIN anchor a ON s.strategy_id = a.strategy_id AND s.started_at < a.started_at
  ORDER BY s.started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), start_nav AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p WHERE p.session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM prev_session) ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p WHERE p.session_id IN ($session) AND TRUE ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)) AS v), latest AS (SELECT portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT 100.0 * (latest.portfolio_value / NULLIF(start_nav.v, 0) - 1) AS pnl_pct FROM latest, start_nav;

spec.title: Portfolio value (M IRT)
spec.description: Latest mark-to-mid NAV from portfolio_snapshot across selected sessions (IRR / 1e7).

spec.rawSql: SELECT portfolio_value / 1e7 AS portfolio_m_irt FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

spec.title: Turnover (×)
spec.description: Sum(fill notional) / latest NAV. Both buy+sell legs count: ≈2 ≈ one full book renew (sold once + bought once). From pair_trade.fill.

spec.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.amount * f.price) FROM pair_trade.fill f WHERE f.session_id IN ($session)), 0) / NULLIF(latest.v, 0) AS turnover FROM latest;

spec.title: Commission / NAV (%)
spec.description: 100 × sum(fill.fee_quote) / latest NAV — total commission as % of portfolio.

spec.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT portfolio_value AS v FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT 100.0 * COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.fee_quote) FROM pair_trade.fill f WHERE f.session_id IN ($session)), 0) / NULLIF(latest.v, 0) AS commission_pct FROM latest;

spec.title: Portfolio value (M IRT)
spec.description: Mark-to-mid NAV over trading-time from portfolio_snapshot. Skips Tehran Thu/Fri; null between sessions (no overnight/weekend flat connector). Only rows with local clock time 12:00–18:00 (Asia/Tehran) are included (pre-open snapshots excluded). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH sess_ord AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at) - 1 AS sess_ord
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  WHERE s.id IN ($session)
),
pts AS (
  SELECT session_id, ts AS real_ts, portfolio_value / 1e7 AS v
  FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot
  WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND ((ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00') AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')) NOT IN (4, 5)
),
src AS (
  SELECT session_id, real_ts, v FROM pts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.session_id, MAX(p.real_ts) + INTERVAL '1 second', NULL
  FROM pts p
  JOIN sess_ord so ON so.session_id = p.session_id
  WHERE so.sess_ord < (SELECT MAX(sess_ord) FROM sess_ord)
  GROUP BY p.session_id
),

tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
)
SELECT m.time, s.v AS "Portfolio M IRT"
FROM src s
JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts
ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Portfolio return vs benchmark indexes (%)
spec.description: Portfolio % vs equal-weight mid indexes from portfolio_snapshot.marks (1‑min). Shared baseline = prior-session last NAV / last marks; fallback = first in-window. All = every mark key; Top5 = عیار، طلا، کهربا، گنج، مثقال. Skips Tehran Thu/Fri; null between sessions (no overnight/weekend flat connector). Source query for the excess panel (Dashboard datasource). Only rows with local clock time 12:00–18:00 (Asia/Tehran) are included (pre-open snapshots excluded). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
anchor AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.started_at, s.strategy_id
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  WHERE s.id IN ($session)
  ORDER BY s.started_at
  LIMIT 1
),
prev_session AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  JOIN anchor a ON s.strategy_id = a.strategy_id AND s.started_at < a.started_at
  ORDER BY s.started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
nav0 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
     WHERE p.session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM prev_session)
     ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
     WHERE p.session_id IN ($session) AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00') AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')) NOT IN (4, 5)
     ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)
  ) AS v
),
base_marks AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
     WHERE p.session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM prev_session)
     ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
     WHERE p.session_id IN ($session) AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00') AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')) NOT IN (4, 5)
     ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)
  ) AS marks
),
m0 AS (
  SELECT split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) AS asset, kv.value::numeric AS m0
  FROM base_marks b
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(b.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  WHERE kv.value::numeric > 0
),
sess_ord AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at) - 1 AS sess_ord
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  WHERE s.id IN ($session)
),
pts AS (
  SELECT p.session_id,
         p.ts AS real_ts,
         100.0 * (p.portfolio_value / NULLIF(n.v, 0) - 1) AS port_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1)) AS all_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1))
           FILTER (WHERE split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) IN ('IRTKMOFD0001', 'IRTKLOTF0001', 'IRTKROBA0001', 'IRTKGANJ0001', 'IRTKZARA0001')) AS top5_pct
  FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
  CROSS JOIN nav0 n
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  JOIN m0 m ON m.asset = split_part(kv.key, '-', 1)
  WHERE p.session_id IN ($session)
    AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
    AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')) NOT IN (4, 5)
    AND kv.value::numeric > 0
  GROUP BY p.session_id, p.ts, p.portfolio_value, n.v
),
src AS (
  SELECT session_id, real_ts, port_pct, all_pct, top5_pct FROM pts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.session_id, MAX(p.real_ts) + INTERVAL '1 second', NULL, NULL, NULL
  FROM pts p
  JOIN sess_ord so ON so.session_id = p.session_id
  WHERE so.sess_ord < (SELECT MAX(sess_ord) FROM sess_ord)
  GROUP BY p.session_id
),

tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
)
SELECT m.time, s.port_pct AS "Portfolio %", s.all_pct AS "All index %", s.top5_pct AS "Top5 index %", s.port_pct - s.all_pct AS "Excess vs All %", s.port_pct - s.top5_pct AS "Excess vs Top5 %"
FROM src s
JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts
ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Portfolio excess return vs indexes (%)
spec.description: Portfolio % minus each equal-weight mid index % (shared prior-session close baselines). Positive = outperforming that benchmark. Reuses the return panel query via Grafana Dashboard datasource (no second Postgres round-trip). Same Thu/Fri + session-break rules. Only rows with local clock time 12:00–18:00 (Asia/Tehran) are included (pre-open snapshots excluded). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.title: Portfolio return vs benchmark indexes (%) — cumulative
spec.description: Style 6: all selected sessions on real wall-clock. Each day is shifted by the sum of earlier sessions’ end port/index % (vs that session’s prior close). Additive cumulative from the first selected session. Line interpolation = stepAfter (holds across gaps). Only rows with local clock time 12:00–18:00 (Asia/Tehran) are included (pre-open snapshots excluded).

spec.rawSql:
WITH sess_ord AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.started_at, s.strategy_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at) - 1 AS sess_ord
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  WHERE s.id IN ($session)
),
sess_prev AS (
  SELECT so.session_id, so.sess_ord,
         (
           SELECT s2.id FROM pair_trade.session s2
           WHERE s2.strategy_id = so.strategy_id AND s2.started_at < so.started_at
           ORDER BY s2.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
         ) AS prev_id
  FROM sess_ord so
),
sess_nav0 AS (
  SELECT sp.session_id,
         COALESCE(
           (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.prev_id ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.session_id AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
            ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)
         ) AS v
  FROM sess_prev sp
),
sess_marks0 AS (
  SELECT sp.session_id,
         COALESCE(
           (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.prev_id ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.session_id AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
            ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)
         ) AS marks
  FROM sess_prev sp
),
m0 AS (
  SELECT sm.session_id, split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) AS asset, kv.value::numeric AS m0
  FROM sess_marks0 sm
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(sm.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  WHERE kv.value::numeric > 0
),
raw AS (
  SELECT p.session_id,
         p.ts AS real_ts,
         100.0 * (p.portfolio_value / NULLIF(n.v, 0) - 1) AS port_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1)) AS all_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1))
           FILTER (WHERE split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) IN ('IRTKMOFD0001', 'IRTKLOTF0001', 'IRTKROBA0001', 'IRTKGANJ0001', 'IRTKZARA0001')) AS top5_pct
  FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
  JOIN sess_nav0 n ON n.session_id = p.session_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  JOIN m0 m ON m.session_id = p.session_id AND m.asset = split_part(kv.key, '-', 1)
  WHERE p.session_id IN ($session)
    AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
    AND kv.value::numeric > 0
  GROUP BY p.session_id, p.ts, p.portfolio_value, n.v
),
sess_end AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.session_id)
         r.session_id, r.port_pct, r.all_pct, r.top5_pct,
         r.port_pct - r.all_pct AS xs_all,
         r.port_pct - r.top5_pct AS xs_top5
  FROM raw r
  ORDER BY r.session_id, r.real_ts DESC
),
sess_off AS (
  SELECT so.session_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.port_pct) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS port_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.all_pct) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS all_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.top5_pct) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS top5_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.xs_all) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS xs_all_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.xs_top5) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS xs_top5_off
  FROM sess_ord so
  JOIN sess_end e ON e.session_id = so.session_id
)
SELECT r.real_ts AS time,
       r.port_pct + o.port_off AS "Portfolio %",
       r.all_pct + o.all_off AS "All index %",
       r.top5_pct + o.top5_off AS "Top5 index %",
       (r.port_pct - r.all_pct) + o.xs_all_off AS "Excess vs All %",
       (r.port_pct - r.top5_pct) + o.xs_top5_off AS "Excess vs Top5 %"
FROM raw r
JOIN sess_off o ON o.session_id = r.session_id
ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: Portfolio excess return vs indexes (%) — cumulative
spec.description: Style 6: cumulative excess = port − index with per-session baselines + sum of earlier sessions’ end excess. stepAfter line (continuous across session gaps). Reuses the cumulative return panel query. Only rows with local clock time 12:00–18:00 (Asia/Tehran) are included (pre-open snapshots excluded).

spec.title: Portfolio weights by asset (%)
spec.description: Share of mark-to-mid NAV per asset (Persian labels via static IR map; نقد = cash). Stacked area ≈ 100%. X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH sym_map AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('IRTKALTN0001', 'آلتون'), ('IRTKATSH0001', 'آتش'), ('IRTKDORN0001', 'درنا'), ('IRTKDRKS0001', 'درخشان'), ('IRTKEMRL0001', 'امرالد'), ('IRTKGANJ0001', 'گنج'), ('IRTKGHIR0001', 'قیراط'), ('IRTKGOLD0001', 'گلدا'), ('IRTKGOLN0001', 'گلدیس'), ('IRTKHAMY0001', 'همیان'), ('IRTKJAMF0001', 'جام طلا'), ('IRTKJAVA0001', 'جواهر'), ('IRTKKIAN0001', 'گوهر'), ('IRTKLIAN0001', 'لیان'), ('IRTKLOTF0001', 'طلا'), ('IRTKMIRA0001', 'میراث'), ('IRTKMOFD0001', 'عیار'), ('IRTKNAAB0001', 'ناب'), ('IRTKNAFS0001', 'نفیس'), ('IRTKNGIN0001', 'نگین فارس'), ('IRTKRITO0001', 'ریتون'), ('IRTKROBA0001', 'کهربا'), ('IRTKROSE0001', 'رز ترنج'), ('IRTKROZG0001', 'رزگلد'), ('IRTKTABA0001', 'تابش'), ('IRTKZARA0001', 'مثقال'), ('IRTKZARF0001', 'زر'), ('IRTKZARG0001', 'زرگر'), ('IRTKZARV0001', 'زروان'), ('IRTKZFAM0001', 'زرفام'), ('IRTKZOMR0001', 'زمرد'), ('IRR', 'نقد')) AS t(asset, label)), src AS (SELECT b.session_id, b.ts AS real_ts, 100.0 * CASE WHEN b.asset = 'IRR' THEN b.total ELSE b.total * COALESCE((SELECT kv.value::numeric FROM jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value) WHERE kv.key LIKE b.asset || '-%' LIMIT 1), 0) END / NULLIF(p.portfolio_value, 0) AS value, COALESCE(sm.label, b.asset) AS metric FROM pair_trade.balance_snapshot b JOIN pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p ON p.session_id = b.session_id AND p.ts = b.ts LEFT JOIN sym_map sm ON sm.asset = b.asset WHERE b.session_id IN ($session)), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.value, s.metric FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Latest portfolio composition (%)
spec.description: Pie of latest asset weights by mark-to-mid value. Persian labels via static IR map; نقد = cash.

spec.rawSql: WITH sym_map AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('IRTKALTN0001', 'آلتون'), ('IRTKATSH0001', 'آتش'), ('IRTKDORN0001', 'درنا'), ('IRTKDRKS0001', 'درخشان'), ('IRTKEMRL0001', 'امرالد'), ('IRTKGANJ0001', 'گنج'), ('IRTKGHIR0001', 'قیراط'), ('IRTKGOLD0001', 'گلدا'), ('IRTKGOLN0001', 'گلدیس'), ('IRTKHAMY0001', 'همیان'), ('IRTKJAMF0001', 'جام طلا'), ('IRTKJAVA0001', 'جواهر'), ('IRTKKIAN0001', 'گوهر'), ('IRTKLIAN0001', 'لیان'), ('IRTKLOTF0001', 'طلا'), ('IRTKMIRA0001', 'میراث'), ('IRTKMOFD0001', 'عیار'), ('IRTKNAAB0001', 'ناب'), ('IRTKNAFS0001', 'نفیس'), ('IRTKNGIN0001', 'نگین فارس'), ('IRTKRITO0001', 'ریتون'), ('IRTKROBA0001', 'کهربا'), ('IRTKROSE0001', 'رز ترنج'), ('IRTKROZG0001', 'رزگلد'), ('IRTKTABA0001', 'تابش'), ('IRTKZARA0001', 'مثقال'), ('IRTKZARF0001', 'زر'), ('IRTKZARG0001', 'زرگر'), ('IRTKZARV0001', 'زروان'), ('IRTKZFAM0001', 'زرفام'), ('IRTKZOMR0001', 'زمرد'), ('IRR', 'نقد')) AS t(asset, label)), latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)), p AS (SELECT ts, portfolio_value, marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND ts = (SELECT ts FROM latest)), b AS (SELECT asset, SUM(total) AS total FROM pair_trade.balance_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND ts = (SELECT ts FROM latest) GROUP BY asset), valued AS (SELECT p.ts AS time, COALESCE(sm.label, b.asset) AS metric, 100.0 * CASE WHEN b.asset = 'IRR' THEN b.total ELSE b.total * COALESCE((SELECT kv.value::numeric FROM jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value) WHERE kv.key = b.asset || '-IRR' OR kv.key LIKE b.asset || '-%' LIMIT 1), 0) END / NULLIF(p.portfolio_value, 0) AS value FROM b CROSS JOIN p LEFT JOIN sym_map sm ON sm.asset = b.asset) SELECT time, value, metric FROM valued WHERE value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC;

spec.title: Quote balance & pending orders
spec.description: Free IRR cash (M IRT) and open strategy order count. X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, ts AS real_ts, quote_balance / 1e7 AS v FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.v AS "Cash M IRT" FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, ts AS real_ts, pending_order_count AS v FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.v AS "Pending orders" FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Held ETF count
spec.description: jsonb_array_length(basket_snapshot.symbols). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, ts AS real_ts, jsonb_array_length(symbols) AS v FROM pair_trade.basket_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.v AS "Held ETFs" FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Return signal by symbol
spec.description: EWM log-mid residual (signal_snapshot.ret). Last selected session only (newest started_at). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, bin_ts AS real_ts, ret AS value, symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id = (SELECT id FROM pair_trade.session WHERE id IN ($session) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) AND ret IS NOT NULL), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.value AS value, s.metric AS metric FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Return signal demeaned (cross-section)
spec.description: ret − mean(ret) per bin_ts across symbols. Last selected session only (newest started_at). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, bin_ts AS real_ts, ret - AVG(ret) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, bin_ts) AS value, symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id = (SELECT id FROM pair_trade.session WHERE id IN ($session) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) AND ret IS NOT NULL), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.value AS value, s.metric AS metric FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Rotation edges (bps)
spec.description: Sell→buy only. expected/last/realized/realized_net ×10000 ≈ bps. Co-timed rotations nudged +1s. Wall-clock x-axis.

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
base AS (
  SELECT id, session_id, ts,
         transition_score, last_edge, realized_edge, realized_edge_net,
         sell_slippage, buy_slippage, latency_sec,
         quote_earned, quote_spent,
         ts + ((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, ts ORDER BY id) - 1)
               * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
         new_symbol || '←' || prev_symbol AS pair
  FROM pair_trade.rotation
  WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
) SELECT time, transition_score * 10000 AS value, 'expected' AS metric FROM base WHERE transition_score IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT time, last_edge * 10000, 'last' FROM base WHERE last_edge IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT time, realized_edge * 10000, 'realized' FROM base WHERE realized_edge IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT time, realized_edge_net * 10000, 'realized_net' FROM base WHERE realized_edge_net IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: Buy / sell slippage (bps)
spec.description: Sell→buy slippage ×10000 ≈ bps. Co-timed rotations nudged +1s. Wall-clock x-axis.

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
base AS (
  SELECT id, session_id, ts,
         transition_score, last_edge, realized_edge, realized_edge_net,
         sell_slippage, buy_slippage, latency_sec,
         quote_earned, quote_spent,
         ts + ((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, ts ORDER BY id) - 1)
               * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
         new_symbol || '←' || prev_symbol AS pair
  FROM pair_trade.rotation
  WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
) SELECT time, sell_slippage * 10000 AS value, 'sell_slippage_bps' AS metric FROM base WHERE sell_slippage IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT time, buy_slippage * 10000, 'buy_slippage_bps' FROM base WHERE buy_slippage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: Rotation latency (sec)
spec.description: Seconds from sell placed to buy_complete. Series name = pair (new←prev); co-timed rotations nudged +1s. Wall-clock x-axis.

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
base AS (
  SELECT id, session_id, ts,
         transition_score, last_edge, realized_edge, realized_edge_net,
         sell_slippage, buy_slippage, latency_sec,
         quote_earned, quote_spent,
         ts + ((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, ts ORDER BY id) - 1)
               * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
         new_symbol || '←' || prev_symbol AS pair
  FROM pair_trade.rotation
  WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
) SELECT time, latency_sec AS value, pair AS metric FROM base WHERE latency_sec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: Cumulative realized edge (NAV-weighted bps)
spec.description: Running sum of contrib_bps = realized_edge×10000×notional/NAV (notional=quote_earned, NAV=prior-session close). Starts at 0 ($__timeFrom); last value held to now. stepAfter. Wall-clock x-axis.

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
anchor AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.started_at, s.strategy_id
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  WHERE s.id IN ($session)
  ORDER BY s.started_at
  LIMIT 1
),
prev_session AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  JOIN anchor a ON s.strategy_id = a.strategy_id AND s.started_at < a.started_at
  ORDER BY s.started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), start_nav AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p WHERE p.session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM prev_session) ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p WHERE p.session_id IN ($session) AND TRUE ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)) AS v), 
base AS (
  SELECT id, session_id, ts,
         transition_score, last_edge, realized_edge, realized_edge_net,
         sell_slippage, buy_slippage, latency_sec,
         quote_earned, quote_spent,
         ts + ((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, ts ORDER BY id) - 1)
               * INTERVAL '1 second') AS time,
         new_symbol || '←' || prev_symbol AS pair
  FROM pair_trade.rotation
  WHERE session_id IN ($session) AND prev_symbol <> 'CASH' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
), w AS (SELECT b.time, b.session_id, b.ts, b.id, b.realized_edge * 10000 * COALESCE(NULLIF(b.quote_earned, 0), b.quote_spent) / NULLIF(n.v, 0) AS contrib_bps, b.realized_edge_net * 10000 * COALESCE(NULLIF(b.quote_earned, 0), b.quote_spent) / NULLIF(n.v, 0) AS contrib_net_bps FROM base b CROSS JOIN start_nav n), cum AS (SELECT time, session_id, ts, id, SUM(contrib_bps) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS realized, SUM(contrib_net_bps) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS realized_net FROM w WHERE contrib_bps IS NOT NULL OR contrib_net_bps IS NOT NULL), bounds AS (SELECT to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AS t0, LEAST(NOW(), to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())) AS t1), last AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(realized), 0) AS realized, COALESCE(SUM(realized_net), 0) AS realized_net FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (session_id) realized, realized_net FROM cum ORDER BY session_id, ts DESC, id DESC) s) SELECT b.t0 AS time, 0::float AS value, 'cum realized (NAV-wtd bps)' AS metric FROM bounds b UNION ALL SELECT c.time, c.realized, 'cum realized (NAV-wtd bps)' FROM cum c WHERE c.realized IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.t1, l.realized, 'cum realized (NAV-wtd bps)' FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN last l UNION ALL SELECT b.t0, 0::float, 'cum realized_net (NAV-wtd bps)' FROM bounds b UNION ALL SELECT c.time, c.realized_net, 'cum realized_net (NAV-wtd bps)' FROM cum c WHERE c.realized_net IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.t1, l.realized_net, 'cum realized_net (NAV-wtd bps)' FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN last l ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: Rotation status
spec.description: Distribution of rotation.status across selected sessions.

spec.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*)::float AS value, status AS metric FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE session_id IN ($session) GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC;

spec.title: Bid-ask spread % by symbol
spec.description: BA cost as percent (×100). Last selected session only (newest started_at). X-axis is trading-time (overnight/weekend/between-session gaps removed); samples are spread across the dashboard time range. Hover clock is compressed, not wall-clock. Filter via Session multi-select.

spec.rawSql:
WITH src AS (SELECT session_id, bin_ts AS real_ts, ba_spread * 100 AS value, symbol AS metric FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id = (SELECT id FROM pair_trade.session WHERE id IN ($session) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) AND ba_spread IS NOT NULL), 
tmap AS (
  SELECT d.session_id,
         d.real_ts,
         to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())
           + (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at, d.real_ts) - 1)
           * (($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom())
              / GREATEST(COUNT(*) OVER (), 1))
           * INTERVAL '1 second' AS time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session_id, real_ts FROM src) d
  JOIN pair_trade.session s ON s.id = d.session_id
) SELECT m.time, s.value AS value, s.metric AS metric FROM src s JOIN tmap m ON m.session_id = s.session_id AND m.real_ts = s.real_ts ORDER BY m.time;

spec.title: Latest signals (all symbols)
spec.description: Latest freq bin across selected sessions. Ordered by ret+ba_spread ASC.

spec.rawSql: SELECT s.symbol, s.ret, s.ba_spread, s.mid_price / 1e7 AS mid_m_irt, s.ret_ask, s.ret_bid, s.ask_price / 1e7 AS ask_m_irt, s.bid_price / 1e7 AS bid_m_irt, (s.ret + s.ba_spread) AS ret_plus_spread, s.bin_ts, s.session_id FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot s WHERE s.session_id IN ($session) AND s.bin_ts = (SELECT MAX(bin_ts) FROM pair_trade.signal_snapshot WHERE session_id IN ($session)) ORDER BY s.ret + s.ba_spread ASC NULLS LAST;
